shared_elements: horizontal band or register of repeated motifs
rounded/oval shapes arranged in a row
weathered, partially eroded decorated surface in an excavation setting
justification: The only real correspondence is organisational: both surfaces carry a horizontal run of repeated rounded motifs across an ochre-coloured ground, and both are photographed in situ amid excavation debris. Otherwise they differ fundamentally — A is flat red pigment applied to a plastered earthen wall with vague, near-illegible blobs, while B is deeply carved stone relief with crisply modelled animals, birds and a zigzag frieze stacked in distinct registers.
